stem: Which sentence from the story best supports the idea that taking great photographs requires some effort?

options.label: A
options.text: When her father examined her blurred images and aimless shots, he advised Michelle to look through the lens and think about what the resulting picture would look like. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: That picture still hangs on her bedroom wall. (paragraph 1)

options.label: C
options.text: "We turn in the roll of film, it gets developed, and then we choose which picture we want to enter into the contest, just to make sure everything is fair." (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: "I have to do my homework and think about something besides the contest." (paragraph 9)
